name: A Sprinkle of Love
source:
On a rainy afternoon, Aoi stumbles into a small neighborhood bakery and meets Hana—the quiet girl behind the counter with a love for pastries and shy smiles. What begins as a simple purchase slowly turns into something sweeter, as small conversations and shared moments bring them closer together.

[From [url=https://thatnewdevgirl.itch.io/a-sprinkle-of-love-a-yuri-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个下雨的下午，葵无意中走进了附近的一家小面包店，遇到了哈娜——柜台后面那个安静的女孩，她喜欢糕点，脸上挂着害羞的微笑。最初的简单购买慢慢变成了更甜蜜的事情，因为短暂的交谈和分享的时刻让他们更加亲密。

[来自[url=https://thatnewdevgirl.itch.io/a-sprinkle-of-love-a-yuri-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
